# SECCIØN Platform (seccion.ai)

> SECCIØN is the 1st Fusion Platform combining AI-driven dating matchmaking with a live streaming creator economy.

## Core Value Proposition
- **For Members**: Experience genuine relationships through dynamic 8-level Relationship Level System (RLS v2.0), interactive AI Suggestion Moves, and direct creator streaming.
- **For Creators**: Monetize directly with dynamic PPV, VIP/Master sub passes, live stream tipping, and escrow-backed custom content orders.

## Key Features & Pages
- [Homepage](https://seccion.ai/): Public landing experience showcasing live creator updates and platform onboarding.
- [How We Do](https://seccion.ai/how-we-do): Educational overview of the business model, Warm Paywall philosophy, and relationship mechanics.
- [Become a Creator](https://seccion.ai/become-creator): Founding Creator program overview, 10% platform fee, and instant payout details.
- [Creator Hub](https://seccion.ai/creator-hub): Guidelines, growth tools, and community resources for verified content creators.
- [Vibe Radar](https://seccion.ai/vibe-radar): Real-time spatial discovery preview of verified members and live streams.

## Platform Standards & Compliance
- Full GDPR Art 9/22, DSA Art 17/27, and 18 U.S.C. 2257 adult content compliance.
- Biometric KYC verification powered by EU Digital Identity Wallet zero-knowledge proof tokens.
